name: a straight-line conversation, ending in a code proposal

reply.text: A loop repeats a set of instructions. What is the part of your program you find yourself writing over and over?

Good — the three lines that draw a circle. Those can go in a loop.

Want me to make that change?
I moved the drawing into a loop that runs five times.

answer.explanation: The three drawing lines now run inside a loop, so changing how many circles you get is a matter of changing one number.

fallback.text: I can help with the code in this project — try asking about the part you are stuck on.
